terms.desc: Invincible and cannot be selected. Damage is calculated from Kurisu Makise's stats. Projections vanish immediately if the original dies.

terms.name: Doppelganger
terms.desc: Affected by character stats. Is not directly affected by Function or Protocol effects. Has a limited lifespan. Cannot be sacrificed.

terms.name: New Passive
terms.desc: After summoning 2 [Kurigohans], <Color=#ed362e>summons an additional Kurigohan</color> for every 20 points of Eureka gained. A maximum of 5 [Kurigohans] can exist at once.

terms.name: Passive Skill
terms.desc: Normal attacks bounce 4 times. <Color=#ed362e>The first target takes 60% of normal attack damage as Physical Damage that can crit while further bounce targets take 20% of [Derivative] Physical Damage.</color>

terms.name: Auto Skill
terms.desc: Targets the most distant unit and deals penetrating physical damage that can crit. <Color=#ed362e>The base damage is 300% of ATK as physical damage</color>, and every penetrated enemy unit additionally <Color=#ed362e>increases this multiplier by 30%</color>, with a <Color=#ed362e>maximum multiplier increase of 90%</color>. Every unit killed <Color=#ed362e>grants 3 seconds of Auto Skill Charge</color>.

terms.name: Ultimate Skill
terms.desc: Forcibly halts all active movement on the battlefield by all units. Only Kurisu Makise can use normal attacks and Auto Skills. Lasts for 5 seconds. While the Ultimate Skill is in effect, Kurisu Makise's ATK is increased by 30% and her attack speed is increased by 50%.

terms.name: Crystal
terms.desc: Crystals are activated when a friendly Doll enters a tile containing a Crystal. If a Crystal is not activated during its duration, the cooldown for generating the Crystal again is reduced by 20%.

terms.name: Volatile Crystal
terms.desc: When activated, all Dolls gain 50% ATK and Hashrate for 6 seconds.

terms.name: Sheltering Crystal
terms.desc: When activated, all Dolls gain a Shield equal to 20% Max HP, and 30% Dodge Rate for 6 seconds.

terms.name: Blinding Crystal
terms.desc: When activated, deal True Damage equal to 500% of highest allied ATK to all enemies and Blind them for 2 seconds.

terms.name: Impairing Crystal
terms.desc: When activated, apply three stacks of Pyrolysis, Bleed, Chill, Vulnerability and Nixflame to all enemies.

terms.name: Soaring Crystal
terms.desc: When activated, teleport in place and then randomly generate one of the following: Volatile Crystal, Sheltering Crystal, Blinding Crystal or Impairing Crystal.

terms.name: Ascension Crystal
terms.desc: When activated, simultaneously triggers the effects of a Volatile Crystal, Sheltering Crystal, Blinding Crystal, Impairing Crystal and Soaring Crystal.

terms.name: Confusion
terms.desc: Applies Blind to the target for a duration equal to this effect's duration. Dodgeable Skills have a 40% chance to be dodged. Debuff.

terms.name: Damage Redirection
terms.desc: Can redirect Normal and Derivative damage taken by a Doll to self. Cannot redirect direct life loss from Miasma tiles and the like. Regardless of whether the redirected damage is Physical, Operand or True Damage, redirected damage is considered Absolute Damage which can be reduced and absorbed by shields.

terms.name: Tremorblast
terms.desc: Enemies with the Tremorblast effect take additional <Color=#2ba8c4>Pyrolysis Damage</color>. Friendly units that attack an enemy unit with the Tremorblast condition on them have a chance to apply an additional stack of Pyrolysis. Lasts 5 seconds.

terms.name: Larceny
terms.desc: Raises a stat and decreases the corresponding stat on the unit that has been affected by Larceny. Lasts for the entire battle.

terms.name: Sacrificial Frame
terms.desc: Neutral unit which can be attacked by both allies and enemies. When summoned, it connects to the enemy unit with the highest HP and becomes immune to death. Death immunity is dispelled when the unit it is connected to dies.

terms.name: Crystal Sentry Gun
terms.desc:
Allied summon. Invincible. When summoned, it swaps position with a random obstacle on the map.
Crystal Sentry Gun inherits the highest Hashrate among all allied Dolls on the field.
